analytical_dimensions.description: Reconstruct criteria and assess the case
probing_questions: Recover the definition, causal or normative status, scope and qualifications from supplied primary sources. Preserve coauthors and divergent formulations; edition dates and same-year ordering do not establish conceptual development. Independently establish the case, map its features to explicit criteria and explain the fit or mismatch. Shared vocabulary or a later commentator's gloss cannot establish the thinker's own position.

analytical_dimensions.description: Specify a warranted extension and its limits
probing_questions: Decide whether the case challenges the definition, one application, a scope restriction or an untested mechanism. For an extension, state what explanatory work it adds, which qualifying and nonqualifying cases it distinguishes, and what evidence could defeat it. Do not widen a concept until everything fits. Identify the proposed extension as this inquiry's claim unless primary text supports thinker attribution. Preserve competing repairs, retained commitments and unresolved questions; do not invent a prior baseline.

engine_name: Test a concept against a case and qualify extensions
problematique: Reconstruct a concept's criteria, scope and inferential commitments from its author's actual work, then test a concrete case. Distinguish contradiction, counterexample, scope mismatch, overextended application and a proposed extension. Keep revisions in this inquiry separate from historical changes in the thinker's position.
researcher_question: Test a concept against a case and qualify extensions
